test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the age in years of the revolutionary Bhagat Singh when he was hanged till death?
solution:
The correct answer is __**23.**__

__
 
• Bhagat Singh was a 23-year-old** revolutionary when he was hanged till death.**
 
• **Bhagat Singh** was an Indian communist revolutionary whose two acts of spectacular brutality against the British in India and execution at the age of 23 made him a famous hero of the Indian independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The freedom fighters Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru were hanged to death in 1931.
 
• In December 1928, Bhagat Singh and an associate, Shivaram Rajguru, fatally shot a 21-year-old British police officer, John Saunders in Lahore.
 
• Surfacing again in April 1929, Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt, set off two homemade bombs inside the Central Legislative Assembly in Delhi. 
 
• 23 March is observed as Shaheed Diwas (Martyr's Day).
 
• In India, shaheed Diwas is observed twice a year - one is on 23 March and the other on 30 January, the day when Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated.
